text: When Ephraim spoke there was terror;he was exalted in Israel; [1]but he became guilty through Baal and died.

Now they continue to sin,making for themselves molten images,Silver idols according to their skill, [AA]all of them the work of artisans."To these, offer sacrifice," they say.People kiss calves! [2] [AB]
Therefore, they will be like a morning cloudor like the dew that vanishes with the dawn,Like chaff storm-driven from the threshing floor [AC]or like smoke out of the window.
I, the Lord, am your God,since the land of Egypt; [3] [AD]Gods apart from me you do not know;there is no savior but me. [AE]
I fed you in the wilderness,in the parched land.
When I fed them, they were satisfied;when satisfied, they became proud,therefore they forgot me.
So, I will be like a lion to them,like a leopard by the road I will keep watch.
t[AF] I will attack them like a bear robbed of its young,and tear their hearts from their breasts;I will devour them on the spot like a lion,as a wild animal would rip them open.
t[4] I destroy you, Israel!who is there to help you?
Where now is your king,that he may rescue you?And all your princes,that they may defend you?Of whom you said,"Give me a king and princes"? [AG]
I give you a king in my anger,and I take him away in my wrath. [5]
The guilt of Ephraim is wrapped up,his sin is stored away.
t[6] The birth pangs will come for him, [AH]but this is an unwise child,Who, when it is time, does not present himselfat the mouth of the womb. [AI]
t[7] Shall I deliver them from the power of Sheol?shall I redeem them from death?Where are your plagues, O death!where is your sting, Sheol! [AJ]Compassion is hidden from my eyes.

Though Ephraim [8] may flourish among his brothers,an east wind [AK] will come, a wind from the Lord,rising from the wilderness,That will dry up his spring,and leave his fountain dry.It will loot his treasuryof every precious thing.
